::: {.callout-note}
## Working research proposition
Province-wide availability around 1995 remains an open question. A November 2008 program-review synthesis has now been inspected via a public scan. Current program pages and policy manuals describe today’s CSIL; they are not a 1990s history.
:::

## What this chapter is for

Later work can track how CSIL changed after a design/pilot period: eligibility, administration, reviews, and public documentation. This chapter should stay source-led and should not become a policy-recommendation page.

## Evidence status

- **Inspected later official sources:** [2008 synthesis](../sources/wanted-2008-program-review.qmd); [2011 rate-increase news release](../sources/bc-gov-news-2011-csil-rates.qmd); [HCC Policy Manual ch. 4](../sources/hcc-policy-manual-csil.qmd); [current provincial CSIL page](../sources/gov-bc-csil-program-page.qmd); [SCI BC workbook](../sources/sci-bc-csil-workbook.qmd).
- **Hansard lead only:** [2000 index entry](../sources/hansard-2000-csil-index.qmd) (transcript not read).
- **Open questions:** when and how CSIL became available province-wide; whereabouts of the 2006 ministry background papers, BCPA compilation, and VIHA review cited in 2008.
